verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a general in-app feature that an authenticator app could ship, so this axis applies. The evidence covers only 2FA code management (scanning, importing, exporting, sharing, backups, lock screens) and never mentions an in-product AI assistant or task delegation. The CLI, scripting and llms.txt items are developer or adjacent tooling, not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
